bundle.shortDescription: Show file library for video switchers
bundle.longDescription: Keep a library of video switcher show files with version history. Inspect the patch, screens, layers and presets, generate PDF documentation, test patterns, multiviewer layouts and Companion pages, convert between Barco Event Master and Analog Way LivePremier, and pull from or push to live hardware.
